changelog: 1.2.0 (Jellyfin 12.2 to 12.4): a New releases row shows what has just come out in each account's country (theaters, digital, TV), movies and series. Each account's country is detected (browser time zone and languages, Jellyfin language, usual subtitles) or chosen: one country, several, or international. A new Title origin factor gently lifts titles in a language and from a country familiar to the account. With the Plugin Pages plugin, every user gets a Reco+ page to set their country and titles outside the library. Popular becomes Most popular of all time (TMDb's most voted titles), and every current list renews each day (adjustable). A title you requested goes on top of For you and of banners such as Media Bar Enhanced for 3 days when it arrives, then takes its normal place. Fixes: Popular and New releases only listed titles in the server's language (Seerr filter); switching extended mode back on now recomputes at once; the settings page uses Jellyfin's own look, the full width and no folded sections. Security: Seerr and the webhook never follow redirects, Seerr answers are size-limited, the secrets file is private.
description: Personal recommendations that replace Jellyfin's own.
